class.name: StationServer
class.brief_description: The stations of a scenery, the timetables of the trains calling at them and their runs, and the dispatch of a train at a stop.
class.description: A station has a name it is also found by ([method station_find_by_name]) and the tracks where a train stops at or passes it, its stop points. A timetable is a plan only: the name of its train and its entries, each a station with its planned arrival and departure; any number of trains may run by one. A run is a timetable run by a trainset: whoever drives the train moves it on from entry to entry ([method run_next_entry]), and the server records what the train did at the stations and works out how late it is ([method run_get_delay]). A dispatch is kept under the vehicle the train is driven from. Its steps follow one another as the cars report them done: the passengers exchanged ([signal RailVehicleLoad.load_exchange_finished]), the train let go ([method dispatch_depart]), its doors closed ([signal RailVehicleDoors.doors_closed]). The cars open their doors and exchange by themselves; whoever drives works the cab's doors as [signal dispatch_step_changed] asks. The original keeps this as a negative [code]fStopTime[/code] of the driver and its [code]Doors()[/code] (Driver.cpp:1233-1241, 4266-4356, 6767-6801).

method.name: dispatch_cancel
method.description: Drops the dispatch - the train left the stop.

method.name: dispatch_depart
method.description: The train may go as far as its timetable says: once its passengers are done, its doors close and the dispatch is over.

method.name: dispatch_get_exchange_time
method.description: The seconds the longest exchange of the dispatch still takes, 0 when none.

method.name: dispatch_get_step
method.description: The step of the train's dispatch, [constant DISPATCH_STEP_NONE] without one.

method.name: dispatch_start
method.description: Starts the dispatch of the train driven from [param vehicle], of [param cars]: those whose load is being exchanged ([method RailVehicleServer.load_add], [method RailVehicleServer.load_remove]) are waited for. The train's earlier dispatch is dropped.

method.name: run_create
method.description: The trainset [param trainset] runs [param timetable], its times shifted by [param offset] hours, from its first entry - standing there from now where no arrival is planned. A trainset has one run at a time: [code]RID()[/code] for one that has. Coupled into another trainset, a run goes with it where that one has none and ends where it has; it ends with its trainset.

method.name: run_entry_get_actual_arrival
method.description: When the train arrived at the entry, hours since midnight; [constant NO_TIME] until it did.

method.name: run_entry_get_actual_departure
method.description: When the train left the entry, or passed it where it does not stop, hours since midnight; [constant NO_TIME] until it did.

method.name: run_find_by_trainset
method.description: The run of [param trainset], [code]RID()[/code] for none.

method.name: run_free
method.description: Ends the run.

method.name: run_get_current_entry
method.description: The entry the train drives to or stands at; the entry count once it is past the last.

method.name: run_get_delay
method.description: How late the train is at [param time] [lb]min[rb], early when negative - as on a railway: the delay recorded last (of the arrival, the departure or the passing), or more once the clock has passed the planned time of where the train has not got to: the current entry's arrival on the way to it, its departure where the train stands there or passes it. The shorter way round the clock.

method.name: run_get_offset
method.description: How many hours the run's times are the timetable's shifted.

method.name: run_get_time_to_departure
method.description: The minutes from [param time] to the departure from the current entry - negative once it is past; 0 where the train passes it.

method.name: run_get_timetable
method.description: The timetable the run runs.

method.name: run_get_trainset
method.description: The trainset that runs it.

method.name: run_next_entry
method.description: On to the next entry - by whoever drives the train. The server records the arrival, the departure and the passing at the current entry's station by its stop points: the train stopping on one has arrived, starting off from the entry it stands at has left it, coming onto one moving where it does not stop has passed it.

method.name: run_previous_entry
method.description: Back to the entry before.

method.name: station_add_stop_point
method.description: Adds [param track] to the tracks where a train stops at or passes the station - once.

method.name: station_clear_stop_points
method.description: The station has no stop points any more.

method.name: station_create
method.description: A new station, with no name and no stop points.

method.name: station_find_by_name
method.description: The station of [param name], [code]RID()[/code] for none. The station named so last is found.

method.name: station_free
method.description: Frees the station. Refused while a timetable calls at it.

method.name: station_get_name
method.description: The station's name.

method.name: station_get_stop_points
method.description: The tracks where a train stops at or passes the station.

method.name: station_get_type
method.description: What the station is: a station, or a passenger stop.

method.name: station_list
method.description: Every station.

method.name: station_set_name
method.description: Names the station; [method station_find_by_name] finds it by the new name, no longer by the old one.

method.name: station_set_type
method.description: Says what the station is - [constant STATION_TYPE_STATION], or [constant STATION_TYPE_PASSENGER_STOP], a small stop where fewer get on and off.

method.name: timetable_add_entry
method.description: Adds [param station] at the end of the timetable, planned to arrive at [param arrival] and depart at [param departure], hours since midnight - [constant NO_TIME] for an arrival where the train passes without stopping. Returns the entry's index, -1 for an unknown timetable or station.

method.name: timetable_create
method.description: A new timetable, with no entries.

method.name: timetable_entry_get_arrival
method.description: The arrival planned at the entry, hours since midnight; [constant NO_TIME] where the train passes.

method.name: timetable_entry_get_departure
method.description: The departure planned from the entry, hours since midnight - the time it passes where it does not stop.

method.name: timetable_entry_get_extra
method.description: What a plugin keeps of its own about the entry ([method timetable_entry_set_extra]).

method.name: timetable_entry_get_kilometre
method.description: Where the entry's station is on the line [lb]km[rb].

method.name: timetable_entry_get_radio_channel
method.description: The radio channel from the entry on, [constant NO_RADIO_CHANNEL] for none.

method.name: timetable_entry_get_running_time
method.description: The running time to the entry [lb]min[rb].

method.name: timetable_entry_get_speed_limit
method.description: The speed limit on the way to the entry [lb]km/h[rb], [constant NO_SPEED_LIMIT] for none.

method.name: timetable_entry_get_station
method.description: The entry's station.

method.name: timetable_entry_get_track_count
method.description: The line's tracks on the way to the entry, 1 or 2.

method.name: timetable_entry_is_direction_change
method.description: Whether the train changes its direction at the entry.

method.name: timetable_entry_is_stop
method.description: Whether the train stops at the entry: an arrival is planned there.

method.name: timetable_entry_is_technical_stop
method.description: Whether the stop is a technical one: the train stops for its own sake, nobody gets on or off.

method.name: timetable_entry_set_direction_change
method.description: Says the train changes its direction at the entry.

method.name: timetable_entry_set_extra
method.description: What a plugin keeps of its own about the entry - the core reads none of it.

method.name: timetable_entry_set_kilometre
method.description: Sets where the entry's station is on the line [lb]km[rb].

method.name: timetable_entry_set_radio_channel
method.description: Sets the radio channel from the entry on.

method.name: timetable_entry_set_running_time
method.description: Sets the running time to the entry [lb]min[rb].

method.name: timetable_entry_set_speed_limit
method.description: Sets the speed limit on the way to the entry [lb]km/h[rb].

method.name: timetable_entry_set_technical_stop
method.description: Says the stop is a technical one.

method.name: timetable_entry_set_track_count
method.description: Sets the line's tracks on the way to the entry, 1 or 2.

method.name: timetable_free
method.description: Frees the timetable.

method.name: timetable_get_destination
method.description: The station the train runs to, [code]RID()[/code] for one not said - its relation's end, beyond the entries where it runs on.

method.name: timetable_get_entry_count
method.description: How many entries the timetable has.

method.name: timetable_get_extra
method.description: What a plugin keeps of its own about the timetable ([method timetable_set_extra]).

method.name: timetable_get_origin
method.description: The station the train runs from, [code]RID()[/code] for one not said.

method.name: timetable_get_required_brake_ratio
method.description: The braked weight the train is to have [lb]%[rb], 0 for none required.

method.name: timetable_get_required_locomotive
method.description: The type of the locomotive the train is to have, empty for none required.

method.name: timetable_get_required_mass
method.description: The mass the train is to have [lb]t[rb], 0 for none required - its trainset's own is [method RailVehicleServer.trainset_get_mass].

method.name: timetable_get_speed_limit
method.description: The train's speed limit [lb]km/h[rb], [constant NO_SPEED_LIMIT] for none - of a timetable of no stations, the only limit it gives.

method.name: timetable_get_train_category
method.description: What kind of train it is ([code]Os[/code], [code]Ex[/code]), empty for none said.

method.name: timetable_get_train_label
method.description: The train's own name, empty for none.

method.name: timetable_get_train_name
method.description: The name of the train the timetable is of.

method.name: timetable_set_destination
method.description: Sets the station the train runs to.

method.name: timetable_set_extra
method.description: What a plugin keeps of its own about the timetable - the core reads none of it.

method.name: timetable_set_origin
method.description: Sets the station the train runs from.

method.name: timetable_set_required_brake_ratio
method.description: Sets the braked weight the train is to have [lb]%[rb].

method.name: timetable_set_required_locomotive
method.description: Sets the type of the locomotive the train is to have.

method.name: timetable_set_required_mass
method.description: Sets the mass the train is to have [lb]t[rb].

method.name: timetable_set_speed_limit
method.description: Sets the train's speed limit [lb]km/h[rb].

method.name: timetable_set_train_category
method.description: Sets what kind of train it is.

method.name: timetable_set_train_label
method.description: Sets the train's own name.

method.name: timetable_set_train_name
method.description: Names the train the timetable is of (its number).

signal.name: dispatch_finished
signal.description: The dispatch is over, the train may go.

signal.name: dispatch_step_changed
signal.description: The dispatch of the train driven from [param vehicle] went to another [param step] ([enum DispatchStep]).

signal.name: run_arrived
signal.description: The train of [param run] stopped at a stop point of the station of [param entry].

signal.name: run_created
signal.description: [param run] began: a trainset runs a timetable ([method run_create]).

signal.name: run_departed
signal.description: The train of [param run] standing at [param entry] started off.

signal.name: run_entry_changed
signal.description: [param run] moved on, or back, to [param entry].

signal.name: run_passed
signal.description: The train of [param run] passed the station of [param entry], where it does not stop.

constants.constant: A passenger stop: a small one, where fewer get on and off.
A time left out of a timetable: the arrival where a train passes without stopping.
No radio channel from an entry on.
An entry's kilometre the timetable does not give.
The passengers get off and on.
The exchange is over, the train is not let go yet.
The train is let go: its doors close.
